# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Christine P5](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0005), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Roy is described as being adorably handsome. He possesses glorious dark eyes and is known for a deep, black, velvety smile.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Charming P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 ch.Dawn P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044)_

## Personality

Roy Gardner is a clever and extraordinarily handsome young man known for his unfailing, deferential courtesy and delightful voice. Characterized as a melancholy and inscrutable hero, he lacks a sense of humor, though he writes exquisite compositions in his letters.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 ch.Evening P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022)_

## History

Roy Gardner left college to travel abroad with his mother due to her failing health before returning to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as a handsome student. After rescuing [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during a sudden rainstorm, he began courting her by sending her roses and accompanying her to the [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception. Although his family's unexpected visit to Anne's home proved awkward, Roy later took [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) out to propose to her. However, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) realized she did not love him and rejected his proposal, leaving him devastated.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P1](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0001), [v3 ch.Charming P11](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0011), [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P41](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0041), [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), +10 more_

## Quotes

> “We are schoolmates, I see,” he said, smiling at Anne’s colors. “That ought to be sufficient introduction. My name is Royal Gardner. And you are the Miss Shirley who read the Tennyson paper at the Philomathic the other evening, aren’t you?”
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036)

> "I feel as if I didn’t belong anywhere yet. I put in my Freshman and Sophomore years at Redmond two years ago. I’ve been in Europe ever since. Now I’ve come back to finish my Arts course."
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)

> "I can’t understand it—I can’t believe you are not the woman I’ve believed you to be. But reproaches are idle between us. You are the only woman I can ever love. I thank you for your friendship, at least. Good-bye, Anne."
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Dawn P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)

> “We’d better hurry over to that little pavillion on the point,” suggested the unknown. “We can wait there until this shower is over. It is not likely to rain so heavily very long.”
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P31](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0031)

> "So we are classmates as well as collegemates. I am reconciled to the loss of the years that the locust has eaten,"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P40](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0040)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--roy-gardner.md)

Roy courted [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) for two years, taking her to events such as the [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception and offering her flowers for [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation). Although their social circle anticipated their marriage, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) realized she did not love him when he finally proposed to her during their graduation period. She rejected his proposal, leaving Roy devastated and ending their romantic involvement.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), +14 more_

- Romantically involved with — courted for two years until she refused his proposal  <sub>[v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Confidences P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), +4 more</sub>

### [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--roy-gardner.md)

[Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) is Roy's sister. Along with their mother and another sister, she made an unannounced visit to Patty's Place a day earlier than scheduled, which resulted in an awkward encounter with Anne's unprepared household.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), +3 more_
